source: A note from kecskepasztor
target: Nota a kecskepasztor

source: Hello everybody!
target: Salvete omnes!

source: This is a Monday release!
target: Hoc est emissio diei Lunae!

source: If you see any grammar (or another kind) mistake, please don't hesitate to point it out in the comments!
target: Si quid erroris grammaticae (vel cuiusdam alii generis) videris, quaeso, noli dubitare id in commentariis indicare!

source: Schedule will be Monday/Thursday at minimum, but if I write more then I will post more!
target: Programma saltem erit die Lunae et die Iovis, sed si plura scribam, plura divulgabo!

source: Have fun, and have a nice day!
target: Gaude, et diem iucundum habeas!

source: The two bandits, faces no longer filled with grins but with intense concentration, stood there glaring at him.
target: Duo latrones, quorum vultus iam non risu sed acerrima cogitatione impleti erant, steterunt eum intuentes.

source: Probably surprised that their victim decided to fight back.
target: Fortasse mirati sunt quod victima eorum ad repugnandum constiterat.

source: Not that Sam cared.
target: Non tamen Sam curabat.

source: Compared to the shadow spirit that had possessed the corpse of the bandit leader, they were pitifully slow.
target: Comparati cum spiritu umbratili, qui cadaver ducis latronum possidebat, paeniter lente agebant.

source: “No doubt their main stat is either strength or vitality, maybe endurance…” he thought, as he danced out of the way of the bandit with the daggers, warned by his Mana Sense of the impending attack.
target: "Nullum dubium est: praecipua eorum virtus aut vis, vel fortasse patientia..." cogitavit, dum a latrone cultro armato se distulit, mana sensu imminenti impetu admonitus.

source: At the same time, he raised his own hand, holding his sword, and attacked the one with the ax, while using his other hand to simply shoot a small ball of mana at the man with the sword.
target: Simul manum suam levavit, gladium tenens, et oppugnavit eum qui ascia utebatur, dum altera manu parvam pilam manae in hominem gladio tenentem iaciit.

source: Lucky, in the background, was finishing off the archer.
target: Lucky, in latere, sagittarium occidebat.

source: At this point in the game, mages were rather rare.
target: Ad hoc in ludo, magi satis rari erant.

source: While unlocking mana was an easy and simple affair, making proper use of it was a different thing altogether.
target: Dum mana revelatio facile et simplicis erat, eius rectus usus omnino diversus erat.

source: Plus, learning spells cost money.
target: Praeterea, incantationes discere pecuniam requirebat.

source: And the stronger (or rarer) the spell was, the more it cost.
target: Et quanto potentior (vel rarior) incantatio, tanto magis pecuniam summabat.

source: And at the beginning of the game, not everybody had the money to spend on spells that they can’t fully make use of.
target: Et ad initium ludi, non omnes pecuniam habebant incantationibus impendenda, quarum completa utilitas capi non poterat.

source: Granted, there were already a few gold farming guilds, as with every game, but while it was not known to the populace at large, Sam knew that the game’s system, the very same one, that would chase people out of the tutorial towns was doing its usual machinations to hinder the gold farmers and sellers.
target: Certum est, iam pauca collegia auro colligendi erant, ut in quolibet ludo, sed cum populo latissime ignota erant, Sam sciebat systema ludi, ipsum quod homines ex urbibus initiationis expellebat, consueta machinamenta sua ad agricolas et venditores auri impediendos exercere.

source: The developers didn’t officially ban gold farming, but they sure as hell made sure the gold farmers would suffer.
target: Developatores officialiter auri colligendi negationem non fecerunt, sed tamen firmiter curaverunt ut agricolae auri cruciantur.

source: The moment the mana ball hit the criminal, he cried out in pain and confusion.
target: Instante quo pila manae in scelestum percussit, ille cum dolore et confusione clamitavit.

source: “What the hell! He’s a mage!”
target: "Quid diaboli! Magus est!"

source: Sam just smirked and took a step back, his sword up in a guard position, eyeing the three bandits, while they stared at him with one eye and with the other they watched Lucky, who, after finishing with the archer, kept stalking around the group, ready to pounce.
target: Sam subridens et paulum retrocessit, gladium in custodia tenens, et tribus latronibus intuens, dum illi uno oculo eum intuebantur et altero Lucky spectabant, qui, post sagittarium confectum, circa coetum insidiabatur, praeparatus ad insidendum.

source: “I thought he was a ranger!” called out one of them with slight panic.
target: "Putabam eum esse exploratorem!" exclamavit unus eorum cum parva perturbatione.

source: “I don’t care! Just kill him!” exclaimed the one with the daggers, then tensed his body, and with a small roar, launched one of his blades at him.
target: "Non curo! Interfice eum!" exclamavit ille cultro armatus, deinde corpus contraxit, et parvo rugitu unam ex lamina iaculatus est.

source: “Dagger Strike!”
target: "Ictus Cultro!"

source: Sam just focused more mana into his Mana Shield and tanked the hit.
target: Sam ampliorem manam in scutum manae intendeat et ictum sustinuit.

source: At this level, it was rather easy to calculate the damage it would cause, so he was confident he would be able to take it.
target: Ad hoc gradu, satis facile erat computare damnum quod afferret, itaque confidebat se id subire posse.

source: The three bandits watched with sheer disbelief as the dagger hit Sam squarely in the torso, and then with a quiet clink, bounced off and landed on the ground.
target: Tres latrones incredulitate spectabant, dum culter Sam in pectore exacte percuteret, et deinde cum sonitu parvo, recidit et in terram cecidit.

source: For a moment, there was absolute silence.
target: Per momentum silentium absolutum fuit.

source: Even the forest surrounding them seemed to fall silent, the bandits looking between the dagger on the ground and Sam.
target: Etiam silva, quae eos circumdata erat, silentem afferebat, dum latrones inter culter in terra positum et Sam intuentes erant.

source: Sam smirked at them, raised his sword, and then charged.
target: Sam eis subridens gladium levavit, atque deinde impetum tulit.

source: One strike upwards removed the ax-wielding bandit's weapon hand, the strike following that as Sam turned cut the sword-wielding criminal's throat, and Sam finished the movement by impaling the gaping dagger wielder with his sword.
target: Uno ictu sursum removit manum latronis, qui ascia utebatur; ictus alter, dum Sam se convertit et fauces scelesti gladium gerentis secabat; et Sam motum perfecit, gladium suo latronem cultro operandum infigens.

source: Lucky, taking the opportunity, jumped on the back of the bandit with one less hand, and soon the only sound that could be heard was the chirping of the birds and the movement of the trees as the wind shook them.
target: Lucky, occasionem capiens, in tergum latronis, cuius una manus deleta erat, insiluit, et mox solus sonus auditus erat: cantus avium atque arborum motus, dum ventus eas concutiebat.

source: Sam cleaned his sword and took a look around to see if his attackers dropped something, but it didn’t seem so.
target: Sam gladium purgavit et circumspiciens quaesivit an aggressores aliquid deposuissent, sed ita non videbatur.

source: Shrugging, he motioned to Lucky, and continued his journey towards Ironwood, leaving 4 cooling corpses behind.
target: Humeros levans, ad Lucky signum dedit, et iter suum versus Ironwood continuavit, quattuor corpora refrigerantia relinquens.

source: “Boss, we found something awesome!”
target: "Domine, aliquid praeclarum invenimus!"

source: “What is it?”
target: "Quid est?"

source: “A guy with magic swordsman class!”
target: "Vir cum classe gladii magici!"

source: “There’re no classes in the game, you idiot!”
target: "Nullae classes in ludo sunt, stulte!"

source: “I know, but he used a sword and magic at the same time! And he had a wolf pet!”
target: "Scio, sed simul gladium et magiam utebatur! Et lupum comitem habebat!"

source: “And where did you meet the guy?”
target: "Et ubi convenisti eum?"

source: “Er… we were going to ambush him, but it seems he was higher leveled…”
target: "Er... eum insidiari parati eramus, sed videtur eum gradum superiorem habere..."

source: “How much higher?”
target: "Quantum altius?"

source: “Dunno. None of us had the skill to check.”
target: "Nescio. Nemo nostrum peritiam ad hoc comprobandum habebat."

source: “Damn. What’s his name?”
target: "Maledictum. Quod est nomen eius?"

source: By the time Sam left the forest, his inventory had a few more animal carcasses, mostly made of animals that decided that Lucky and Sam looked like a nice snack.
target: Cum Sam silvam relinquit, inventarium eius pauca animalium cadavera continebat, maxime ex animalibus, quae decreverunt Lucky et Sam speciem ciborum delectabilium esse.

source: They violently disagreed.
target: Vehementer dissentiebant.

source: And his messages were blowing up from several people who seemed to be after the secret of the ‘magical swordsman’ class.
target: Et nuntia eius a pluribus hominibus perveniebant, qui arcanum classis "magici gladiatoris" quaerere videbantur.

source: He received everything from offers for in-game gold to real-life money and some in between.
target: Accepit omnia, ab oblationibus pro auro in ludo ad pecuniam in vita reali, atque intermedia.

source: Apparently, the bandits spread his abilities far and wide.
target: Apparet latrones eius facultates latissime divulgasse.

source: Thankfully, he made sure to only use the basics.
target: Fortunate, constituit solum elementa fundamentalia adhibere.

source: Sam also received several invites to guilds that he knew wouldn’t amount to anything, based on the fact that the other Sam never heard of them.
target: Sam etiam plurimas invitationes ad collegia accepit, quarum nihil futurum esse sciebat, ratione quod alter Sam de eis numquam audiverat.

source: And so much spam…
target: Et ita multa nuntia inania.

source: Thankfully, the mail system was rather robust, so he could set up folders and filters for his mail.
target: Fortunate, systema epistolarum satis robustum erat, ita ut paginas et filtros pro litteris suis constituere posset.

source: For now, he didn’t block anybody, as he didn’t want to hurt anybody’s feelings, but neither did he want to answer them.
target: Ad hoc tempus, neminem vetavit, quoniam nollebat affectus laedere, sed etiam eos respondere non voluit.

source: For now, he had better things to do…
target: Ad hoc tempus, meliora habebat agenda…

source: Cresting over the last hill, finally out of the forest, the small group of man and wolf finally beheld the city of Ironwood.
target: Super ultimo colle ascendens, tandem extra silvas, parva cohors hominis et lupi urbem Ironwood conspexit.

source: It was much like the town of Greenwood, medieval but bigger.
target: Erat similis oppido Greenwood, medii temporis, sed amplior.

source: Its houses were mostly made from its namesake, ironwood.
target: Domus eius praecipue ex ligno ferreo, cui nomen erat, factae erant.

source: A famously hardy and durable wood that can be harvested near the city.
target: Lignum celeberrimum propter firmitatem atque durabilitatem, quod prope urbem meti potest.

source: Granted, they were extremely protected and under constant surveillance, as over the years, the city and people of the kingdom almost caused the extinction of the tree.
target: Certe, valde protegebantur et sub constanti vigilantia manebant, quoniam per annos urbs atque populus regni paene arborem extinguere conati sunt.

source: According to the lore, it was only in the last few decades that the newest leadership of the area decided to properly cultivate and protect the trees.
target: Secundum traditionem, tantum in paucis decadiis nuper, novissima ducatio regionis decrevit arbores rite colere et protegere.

source: Accordingly, the most important quests in the area had to do with the ironwood and the tree nursery.
target: Ergo, quaestiones maximi momenti in regione attinebant ad lignum ferreum et ad hortum arborum.

source: At least the public ones…
target: Saltem quae publicae erant…

source: As the road from the forest joined the bigger one leading to another city, and Sam walked forward to it, he could see countless people walking and riding towards and away from the city.
target: Cum via ex silva ad viam maiorem, quae ad aliam urbem ducebat, se coniungere videbatur, et dum Sam in eam procedebat, innumeros homines ambulantes et equitantes ad urbem ac ab ea discedentes videre poterat.

source: Sam joined the throng of people heading towards the city, keeping Lucky close, as the young wolf kept trying to get away from him and smell everything.
target: Sam turbae hominum, quae ad urbem proficiebantur, se adiunxit, Lucky prope retinens, dum iuvenis lupus ab eo fugit et omnia olfacere conabatur.

source: A few guards to bigger carts, either filled with merchandise or important people, gave him and Lucky an odd look here and there, but he was nowhere powerful enough for them to worry about him.
target: Nonnulli custodes et maiora plaustra, sive mercibus sive personis insignibus completa, intermittentem et peculiarem aspicientiam sibi et Lucky dederunt, sed ille nusquam tam potens apparuit ut eos de eo sollicitaret.

source: Sam didn’t mind, he just simply enjoyed the walk, watching people, taking note of the symbols of the merchant carts, looking through his memories to try to figure out what they might be transporting, practicing with his mana and simply enjoying the game.
target: Sam non curae habebat; iter gaudebat, homines observans, symbola plaustrorum mercatorum notans, per meminisse suas quaerens quid forte transportarent, cum manam exercens et ludo simplicitate fruens.

source: Almost an hour later, he was standing at the civilian entrance of the city, being greeted by a very bored guard.
target: Paene una hora post, stabat ad ingressum civium urbis, ubi a custode valde taedio suffuso salutatus est.

source: “ID please!”
target: "ID, quaeso!"

source: “Here you go, good sir!” he replied, handing over his papers.
target: "Ecce, bone domine!" respondit, chartas suas tradens.

source: There was no room to play nice with these guards, Sam knew very well.
target: Nullum spatium erat ad bene se gerere cum his custodibus, quod Sam bene sciebat.

source: In his inherited memories, there was a very special fail video compilation about the Ironwood city guards.
target: In memoris suis hereditariis, compilatio video errorum peculiare de custodibus urbis Ironwood exstitit.

source: The guard took the card, took a look at it, then at Sam, then finally he waved some kind of artifact that reminded Sam of the metal finders at the airport in his previous life, over the card.
target: Custos chartam accepit, eam inspexit, deinde Sam intuens, atque tandem aliquod genus artificii, quod Sam ad repertores metallorum in portu aeris vitae pristinae reminiscens, super chartam agitavit.

source: When the artifact let out a small, almost silent beep, the guard grunted, tossed the card back at Sam, and motioned for him to move on.
target: Cum artifactus parvum, fere silentem sonum edidisset, custos murmure exclamavit, chartam retro Sam iacuit, et signum dedit ut se moveret.

source: “Have a nice day!” he said, with no enthusiasm.
target: "Diem iucundum habeas!" inquit, sine ulla ardore.

source: As Sam stepped through the gate and beheld his first sight of the massive city, he heard the guard call out behind him.
target: Cum Sam per portam ingrediebatur et primum prospectum urbis ingentis conspexit, custodem post se clamantem audivit.

source: “ID please!”
target: "ID, quaeso!"

source: For the first half an hour, he just wandered around, taking in the sights and smells, making sure to familiarize himself with the map he had seen in his memories, then when that was finished and Lucky and Sam finished their snack that was bought at a roadside stall, he cleaned his hand with his small spell, and headed for the nearest government office.
target: Per primam dimidiimam horam, vagatus est, loca et odores percipiens, et curavit ut consuefactus esset charta, quam in memoriis viderat; deinde, cum illa perfecta essent et Lucky ac Sam suum ientaculum emptionem finivissent, manum parva incantatione purgavit, et ad officium gubernii proximo se contulit.

source: After all, if he wanted to go forward with his goals, he needed to register.
target: Postremo, si proposita sua persequi volebat, se registrare oportuit.

source: Ironwood was in the same kingdom as Greenwood, obviously, but being a bigger city there were more levels of bureaucracy than back at the tutorial town.
target: Ironwood eodem regno ac Greenwood erat, plane, sed quia urbs maior erat, plura erant gradus officiorum bureaucraticorum quam in oppido introductionis.

source: Then, when that was finished, he dropped by the local mage tower, which, for a change, was actually a building with a very spiffy tower built on it.
target: Deinde, cum illa completa essent, in turrim magorum regionalem incidit, quae pro novitate vere erat aedificium cum turrim nitidum superstructam.

source: Opening the door, he was met with a crowd of people all standing around talking, or standing in line waiting to get the attention of one of the girls standing and sitting behind the counters.
target: Ianuam aperiens, convenit multitudo hominum stantium et colloquentium, aut in serie exspectantium ut attentionem alicuius puellae, quae post mensas stabat et sedebat.

source: “Welcome, sonny! I’m Rick and this is mah Racket!” he exclaimed with a cackle as if laughing at his own joke.
target: "Salve, puerule! Ego sum Rick et haec est mea Racket!" exclamavit, cum risu laeto quasi ioca sua ridens.

source: “Tell me if ya find something interesting, young man!” And with that, he sat down on a stool and turned his attention to something that Sam couldn’t see.
target: "Dic mihi, si quid iucundum reperias, iuvene!" inquit. Tum in subsellium consedit et dominum animam convertere coepit in rem, quam Sam videre non poterat.

source: Instantly, his senses lit up with a multitude of items that radiated mana.
target: Statim, sensus eius illustrati sunt multitudine rerum, quae manam efferebant.

source: But Sam discarded all of them, as he knew that what he was looking for was almost inert.
target: Sed Sam omnia abiecit, sciens quod id, quod quaerebat, paene iners esset.

source: Though, to make a show of it, he started walking around and examining the items that his senses marked.
target: Tamen, ut ostentaret, circum ambulare coepit et res quas sensus designaverant perscrutari.

source: To his shock, and maybe a little surprise (and a lot of disgust), most of these items were sexual aids and not anything that he was currently interested in.
target: Ad stuporem eius, et fortasse parva admiratione (ac multo fastidio), pleraque harum rerum erant auxilia sexualia, nec aliquid quod eum praesenti tempore attraheret.

source: Though, he managed to find a box that seemed to hold something that had a similar signature to one of the skill books he had used recently.
target: Attamen, reperit cistam, quae videbatur aliquid continentem, cuius signatura similis erat ad unam ex libris artium, quas nuper adhibuerat.

source: He examined the box in his hands, noting that it was very well made, but there were no seams on it.
target: Cistam in manibus suis examinavit, animadvertens eam optime confectam esse, sed nullas habere suturas.

source: Finally, he held it up and called out to the owner.
target: Tandem eam sustulit et dominum vocavit.

source: “Yo, old man. Know what this is?”
target: "Heus, senex. Scis quid hoc sit?"

source: The old man looked up, squinted a little, then shrugged.
target: Senex surrexit, paulum oculos contraxit, deinde humeros levavit.

source: “Haven’t the foggiest, sonny. I told ya, this is a racket. You buy what you buy. Nothin’ more, nothin’ less.”
target: "Nescio, puerule. Dixi tibi, hoc est racket. Emis quod emis; nihil amplius, nihil minius."

source: Sam snorted, but he didn’t put the box back. He might as well try his luck with it.
target: Sam sufflavit, sed cistam non repressit; fortasse cum ea fortunam tentare voluit.

source: Then after a few minutes of browsing, and a brief argument with Lucky, who wanted to really gnaw on something unsanitary, he finally found it.
target: Post pauca minuta cursu per taberna et brevem contentionem cum Lucky, qui re vera aliquid insalubre masticare vellet, tandem id invenit.

source: A generic off-white mask under a pile of fur cloaks.
target: Larva generica fere in albo pallida, sub congero pallium pilosorum.

source: The only thing special about it was a small, stylized chameleon drawing on the bottom of it.
target: Unum solum rem peculiarem de ea erat: parva imago chameleorum stylizata in eius fundo.

source: Sam was careful to hide his smile, then, as if nothing happened, he continued to browse.
target: Sam risum suum celavit, et deinde, quasi nihil acciderit, explorare continuavit.

source: He picked up an old bag of holding that was able to hold a mountain’s worth of materials but sadly had no weight reduction on it.
target: Eripuit sacculum vetus recondendi, qui materiae montis quantitatem portare posset, sed, pro dolor, nullam reductionem ponderis habebat.

source: Probably why it ended up in the shop.
target: Probabiliter ideo in taberna finivit.

source: Then, finally, he stepped up to the counter and placed his haul down.
target: Tandem ad tabulam accessit et praeda sua deponit.

source: “I want these. How much?”
target: "Haec volo. Quanti?"

source: The old man took a look at the items, hemmed and hawed for a minute then, raised three fingers.
target: Senex res inspexit, paulisper moratus, deinde tres digitos elevavit.

source: “Thirty.”
target: "Triginta."

source: It was Sam’s turn to snort.
target: Iam erat tempus Sam sufflare.

source: “Don’t be ridiculous. Ten at max!”
target: "Noli ridiculum esse. Decem, ad summam!"

source: Rick gave him a big smile, his eyes shining with a predatory gleam.
target: Rick ei magnum risum dedit, oculis praedatori splendore fulgentibus.

source: “Twenty-five.”
target: "Viginti quinque."

source: “They are rather scuffed up. Fifteen.”
target: "Illi satis labefacti sunt. Quindecim."

source: “Twenty.”
target: "Viginti."

source: Sam thought about it, then nodded.
target: Sam de eo cogitavit, deinde annuit.

source: “Twenty, it is.”
target: "Viginti, ita est."

source: The smile on the old man’s face grew, and suddenly a hand was thrust into Sam’s face.
target: Risus in facie senis augebatur, et subito manus in faciem Sam immissa est.

source: “Then, mah payment, sonny!”
target: "Tum, solutio mea, puerule!"

source: Sam grumbled a little, but forked out the required silvers and watched as the man carefully counted them, finally nodding.
target: Sam paulum murmuravit, sed argentum requisitum tradidit, et vidit virum ea diligenter numerare, et tandem annuit.

source: “Alright, they’re yours, young man. No complaints and no buyback!”
target: "Recte, tua sunt, iuvenis. Nulla querela nec reparationis voluntas!"

source: “Understood.” Sam swept the items into his inventory and turned around, Lucky dutifully following him. “Thank you, and have a nice day!”
target: "Intellectum." Sam res in inventarium suum congregavit et revertit, Lucky obsequiose secutus. "Gratias, et diem iucundum habeas!"

source: Outside of the shop, he stepped aside, and in the shadows of his cloak and the alley, he took out the mask, placed a finger on the chameleon symbol, and began channeling magic, while watching with anticipation.
target: Extra tabernam, se declinavit, et in umbris pallii sui et in viae angustae, larvam extraxit, digitum super symbolum chameleonis posuit, et magiam canalizare coepit, cum summa anticipatione spectans.

source: Sam didn’t have to wait long, as, after a minute of channeling, the chameleon symbol flashed in a rainbow color, and the mask changed from the dirty off-white color to pure white, shining with an inner light.
target: Sam non diu exspectare debuit, nam post minutum canalizationis, symbolum chameleonis in colore arcus iridis fulsere, et larva, a sordido colore quasi albissimo ad purum album, mutata est, luce interno splendens.

source: [Chameleon Mask: Created by a hidden master, it allows the user to craft a new face for themselves. Can store a maximum of 3 different faces. After activating, the mask can stay active for an hour, unless charged. Creating a new face has an hour delay.]
target: [Larva Chameleon: Ab magistro occulto creata, sinit usorem novam faciem sibi confingere. Maximum tres facies diversas continere potest. Post activationem, larva per unam horam manere potest activum, nisi onerata fuerit. Novam faciem creandi mora est una hora.]

source: It was extremely hard not to break into evil laughter…
target: Valde difficile erat non in risum malignum erumpere...

target: [Basic Sword Mastery: Gradus 10/10 (MAX%) (Passivum) Ostendit personam gladium ferre posse. Peritia rerum fundamentalium discendo, usor artes provectiores incipere potest. Paululum damnum, quod gladio feris, auget.]

source: [Pinpoint Accuracy: Level 4/5 (65%) (Passive) Your strikes are extremely accurate. Accurate enough that sometimes they slip through the gaps of the armor of your enemies.
target: +5% chance for an attack to deal True Damage that ignores armor]

target: [Stable Stance: Gradus 1/5 (54%) (Passivum) Facit habitum tuum in gladium gerendo magis stabilem. Inimici plus potentiae ad tuam stantiam perturbandam uteri debebunt.]

target: [Basic Footwork: Gradus 3/10 (13%) (Passivum) Probatur te scientiam de principiis pedum agendi adeptum esse. Stance tua magis stabile erit, et minus stamina in pugna consumes.]

source: [Basic Breathing Technique: Level 6/10 (84%) (Passive) You have learned to control your breathing. Decreases stamina consumption during any activity.]
target: [Basic Breathing Technique: Gradus 6/10 (84%) (Passivum) Discebas respirationem tuam regere. Consumptio stamina in qualibet actu minuitur.]

source: [Basic Mana Control: Level 10/10 (MAX %) (Passive) You managed to gain basic control over your own mana. Mastering this skill will allow you to learn more advanced techniques. This skill also increases the amount of mana regenerated at a time.]

source: [Intermediate Mana Control: Level 15/15 (MAX%) (Passive) You understand the basic concepts of mana control. You can now do more, achieve more, and gain more while manipulating mana. target: [Focused Mana Control: Gradus 5/5 (MAX%) (Passivum) Regimen manae in meditatione augetur. Sumptus artium manae minuitur et regeneratio manae augetur sub effectu Meditationis. Bonifica augentur cum sub effectu Deep Meditation skilli sunt!]

source: [Continuous Mana Control: Level MAX (Passive) The longer you control your mana, the more efficient it becomes. The cost of the mana control exercise cannot become zero.]
target: [Continuous Mana Control: Gradus MAX (Passivum) Quo diutius manam regis, eo efficacior fit. Sumptus exercitationis regiminis manae nihil adire non potest.]

source: [Advanced Mana Control: Level 0/20 (79%) (Passive) You reached beyond the basics of mana control. You shape and bend mana to your will. source: [Mana Sense: Level 9/25 (47%) (Active/Passive) A skill that allows you to sense the mana in your surroundings and to make sense of any enchantment that you come across. It also allows you passively to detect magic that affects you.]

source: [Multitasking: Level 20/100 (34%) (Passive) Enhances your ability to use two or more skills at once.]

source: [Mana Synergy: Level 2/10 (6%) (Passive) Thanks to your combining compatible skills, you managed to find a synergy between them. This synergy is completely useless in battle, but when you train your skills and completely focus on them, the rewards from your training increase. Uti cum duabus aut pluribus artibus manae simul extra pugnam, sumptus earum 3% minuitur, dum 1,3 vicibus plus experientiae in disciplina accipis.]
